name: Mysteriously Chosen
body:
The gods granted you a fraction of power.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, Godstouched, level 3+.

Benefit: Select one oracle mystery. This cannot be a mystery you already have. You gain one revelation from the chosen mystery that is available to a 1st-level oracle. For purposes of using that revelation, treat your oracle level as equal to your character level – 2, even if you have levels in oracle.
